- The joint venture does not file its own periodic reports with the SEC; the only public
  primary-filing vehicle in which its realized record could appear is Parker-Hannifin's
  annual reports, in which Parker's retained interest is carried as an equity-method

  earlier "$202 million in proceeds from the sale of a 50 percent equity interest in a

  realized scalar specific to the joint venture. [SRC: SEC accession 0000076334-16-000196, Form 10-K]

  30, 2019 do not mention "GE Aviation" at all; their only references to "joint venture"

  value, equity earnings, impairment, buyout, or dissolution) attributable to the specific
  joint venture. [SRC: SEC accession 0000076334-17-000095, Form 10-K] [SRC: SEC accession 0000076334-18-000087, Form 10-K] [SRC: SEC accession 0000076334-19-000096, Form 10-K]

- No single best-documented realized outcome scalar for the joint venture (net

  equity-method interest is not separately broken out with a trajectory in those filings.
  The realized 3-5-year outcome of the joint venture is therefore **uncertain (no public
  record)**. [SRC: SEC accession 0000076334-16-000196, Form 10-K] [SRC: SEC accession 0000076334-17-000095, Form 10-K] [SRC: SEC accession 0000076334-18-000087, Form 10-K] [SRC: SEC accession 0000076334-19-000096, Form 10-K]
- Parker's consolidated results in these years are not used to infer the joint venture's
  outcome, because the joint venture's results are not separately disclosed within them. [SRC: SEC accession 0000076334-17-000095, Form 10-K]

## Secondary (press) note on continued existence — outside the fixed window
- The joint venture appears to have continued to exist as an ongoing entity: its own
  website presents "Advanced Atomization Technologies (AA TECH)" as "a joint venture
  between Parker Aerospace and GE Aerospace ... created to produce and support advanced
  fuel nozzles and related products for current and future commercial engine platforms,
  including aerospace and aero-derivative engines." This is a present-day description, not
  a dated within-window realized scalar, and is recorded only as secondary context. [SRC: https://advancedatomization.com/about/]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Because the joint venture files no separate SEC reports and Parker-Hannifin does not
  break out the joint venture's trajectory in its fiscal-2016 through fiscal-2019 annual
  reports (the GE Aviation joint venture is named there only in historical/comparative
  context, and not at all after fiscal 2016), there is no public audited 3-5-year realized
  outcome scalar for the joint venture; its outcome is coded **uncertain (no public
  record)**. Secondary press indicates the venture continued to operate, but no

[SLICE END]
